From aca19723604c232ffc6376c1c6cd9c8a12158dcc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Gao Xiang <gaoxiang25@huawei.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2018 11:39:48 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] Revert "staging: erofs: disable compiling temporarile"

This reverts commit 156c3df8d4db4e693c062978186f44079413d74d.

Since XArray and the new mount apis aren't merged in 4.19-rc1
merge window, the BROKEN mark can be reverted directly without
any problems.

Fixes: 156c3df8d4db ("staging: erofs: disable compiling temporarile")
Cc: Matthew Wilcox <willy@infradead.org>
Cc: David Howells <dhowells@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: Chao Yu <yuchao0@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Gao Xiang <gaoxiang25@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/staging/erofs/Kconfig b/drivers/staging/erofs/Kconfig
index 7f209b32228f..c8521d71039b 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/erofs/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/staging/erofs/Kconfig
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 
 config EROFS_FS
 	tristate "EROFS filesystem support"
-	depends on BROKEN
+	depends on BLOCK
 	help
 	  EROFS(Enhanced Read-Only File System) is a lightweight
 	  read-only file system with modern designs (eg. page-sized
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/staging/erofs/Kconfig`**
   - The line `depends on BROKEN` was changed to `depends on BLOCK`. This modification re-enables the compilation of the EROFS filesystem support by removing the BROKEN dependency, which indicates that the feature is not functioning correctly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The patch is a revert of a previous commit that disabled the compilation of the EROFS filesystem by marking it as BROKEN. The current modification restores the ability to compile the EROFS filesystem by changing the dependency from BROKEN to BLOCK, indicating that the feature is now considered stable enough for inclusion. This change is made possible because the necessary components (XArray and new mount APIs) are not merged in the 4.19-rc1 merge window, allowing for the reversion without issues.
